feature: Local release history is available from the interface, with localized text and an English fallback
improvement: Release packages are checked for a complete signing configuration, exact APK contents and reproducible documentation

feature: Symmetric undo / redo, reversible Restore original, crop aspect-ratio presets, and -45° to +45° fine rotation without changing the output dimensions
Expanded drawing with Pen, Highlighter, Mosaic, and Eraser tools, plus draggable multiline text with outline, shadow, and rotation
Editor save choices for source format / JPEG / PNG / WebP, adjustable lossy quality, and lossless WebP on Android 11+
Converter lossless WebP, indexed PNG for images with up to 256 colors, target file size for JPEG / lossy WebP, and a long-edge resize mode that never upscales
Optional safe EXIF preservation while always removing GPS, embedded previews, and opaque metadata and normalizing orientation
fix: Valid images being rejected when BitmapFactory bounds-only inspection correctly returned no bitmap
Unreadable editor tool labels in dark mode
improvement: Expanded state restoration, memory / output-limit enforcement, and regression coverage to 23 suites / 99 tests
Updated all 10-language README files and host instructions from shared sources and added three privacy-safe real-device screenshots

fix: Plugin could not be enabled from the AutoJs6 plugin center because the service returned an empty binding (onNullBinding)

Editor with crop, rotation, flip, brightness, contrast, saturation, color temperature, brush, text, and up to 8 undo steps, with EXIF orientation applied automatically

Converter with JPEG / PNG / WebP output: adjustable quality 1-100, three resize modes (Original / Percentage / Custom), aspect-ratio locking, JPEG background color selection, and live output size estimation
Recognition of bmp / gif / heic / heif / jpg / jpeg / png / webp extensions and all `image/*` MIME types

Plugin metadata, interface, instructions, README, and changelog in 10 languages: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese (Hong Kong / Taiwan), English, French, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Russian, and Arabic
improvement: Preserved editor and converter sessions across configuration changes such as screen rotation, including canvas tools, dialog drafts, conversion options, undo history, and in-flight work

Hardened output MIME validation, bitmap memory recycling, and multi-language resource consistency
dependency: Appended AndroidX ExifInterface 1.4.2 for safely reading image orientation metadata
